findings.description: active_skus is a list, so `scan.sku not in active_skus` scans the whole list for every scan. With a large catalog and many scans (a stocktake can have hundreds of thousands) this is O(scans × skus) and will be very slow.
findings.suggestion: Build a set: `active_skus = {item.sku for item in catalog.active()}`.
findings.title: Linear list membership test inside scan loop makes unknown_locations quadratic
